summary.text: Randy Chamberlin is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 68, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Jocelyn Kent; there is no incumbent in the race.

paragraphs.text: Randy Chamberlin has run for the Montana Legislature before: Ballotpedia lists him as losing the Republican primary for Montana House of Representatives District 64 in 2020 and the general election for Montana State Senate District 32 in 2022.
In 2026 he advanced from the Republican primary for House District 68 on June 2, defeating Jennifer Carlson, 59.1 percent to 40.9 percent.
